generalfeedback.text: Joseph Marie Jacquard used punched cards to control loom weaving patterns, and Herman Hollerith adapted punched cards to tabulate census demographic data.

questiontext.text: Which two high-level programming languages emerged during the Second Generation of computing? (Select two)

generalfeedback.text: FORTRAN (scientific calculation) and COBOL (business data processing) were the two landmark high-level languages developed during the second generation.

questiontext.text: Which of the following devices are classified by size and architecture as microcomputers? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Desktop computers, laptops, and smartphones are microcomputers driven by single microprocessor chips. The IBM Mainframe is an enterprise server.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are vital real-world applications of computers in modern healthcare? (Select two)

generalfeedback.text: MRI/CT scanning and continuous ICU patient vital monitoring are crucial lifesaving applications of medical computers.

questiontext.text: Match each historical computing pioneer to their groundbreaking contribution:

generalfeedback.text: Charles Babbage designed the Analytical Engine; Ada Lovelace wrote the first program; Herman Hollerith automated the 1890 Census; Blaise Pascal built the Pascaline.

questiontext.text: Match each computing generation to its primary electronic hardware component:

generalfeedback.text: 1st Gen used vacuum tubes; 2nd Gen used transistors; 3rd Gen used ICs; 4th Gen introduced microprocessors.

questiontext.text: Match each early calculating device to its defining physical mechanism:

generalfeedback.text: The Abacus uses beads on rods; Napier's Bones uses marked rods; the Slide Rule uses sliding scales; Leibniz's Stepped Reckoner uses a stepped gear drum.

questiontext.text: Match each computer class to its operational definition:

generalfeedback.text: Analog measures continuous data; digital counts binary digits; hybrid combines both techniques; supercomputer performs quadrillions of calculations.

questiontext.text: Match each modern computer application acronym to its societal role:

generalfeedback.text: CBT evaluates tests; ATM dispenses cash 24/7; BVAS accredits voters; CAD aids digital engineering design.
